title: Uncle Buck (1990 TV series)
lead_cast: Kevin MeaneyDah-ve ChodanJacob GelmanLacey ChabertAudrey MeadowsDennis Cockrum Thomas Mikal Ford
premise_summary: Uncle Buck is an American surreal humour television series starring Kevin Meaney, based on the 1989 film of the same name. The series aired on CBS from September 10, 1990 to March 9, 1991 during the 1990–91 season. It is said John Candy of the original film was unavailable due in part to his commitment on the NBC Saturday morning animated series Camp Candy.
